:::{#sol-write-in-matrix-form-score}

For the patient,

$$\vx = \begin{bmatrix} 50 \\ 130 \\ 28 \end{bmatrix}$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\vec w\' \vx
&= (0.4)(50) + (0.2)(130) + (1.5)(28) \\
&= 20 + 26 + 42 \\
&= 88
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(\vx)
&= 88 - 30 \\
&= 58
\end{aligned}
$$

Two things are worth noticing.
The coefficients are not comparable as they stand.
The weight on BMI, $1.5$,
is $7.5$ times the weight on blood pressure, $0.2$,
but the contribution of BMI, $42$,
is less than twice the contribution of blood pressure, $26$,
because the BMI value, $28$,
is much smaller than the blood pressure value, $130$.
So the weight on a feature says nothing on its own
about how much that feature contributes to the score.
And $b = -30$ changes the result:
without it,
the score would be $88$ instead of $58$.

:::
